newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to remain mixed on Monday, ahead of tomorrow's settlement, on profit-taking by speculators in blue chips that had risen sharply in the last few sessions, dealers said.

"Sentiment will remain mixed today," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "The index is likely to come under pressure on booking of profits in blue chips like telecom utility PTCL which jumped during the last trading week."
On Friday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-index rose 12.01 points, or 0.76 percent, to 1,599.11 amid 113 gainers and 96 losers.
Turnover of shares fell to 42.35 million shares from 50.07 million in the previous session.
